_comment: martial_field_loop's NEGATIVE half. Warrior 5 is one level short of [Even Footing] and three short of [Basic Repair], and the innate list carries none of the other martial verbs -- which is what makes every refusal in phase 0 reachable (an unsteady bump, four locked_toasts, a skill_unknown at the carcass). Standing on the floodplains scree chute's north lip (31,3) facing down, clear of every trigger_radius. No combat in the route, so rng_state is inert; borrowed from near_tactician rather than hand-typed.
